address: 377 Yichang Road, Taiping District, Taichung, 411, Taiwan
bio: A time capsule circa 1960s and a get-together hotspot for locals, this restaurant takes you back in time with vintage knickknacks and nostalgic home cooking that is inexpensive and generously served. The gua bao set menu is hugely popular – steamed buns stuffed with braised pork belly, bamboo shoot, pickles and ground peanuts, while the stir-fried beef with Madeira wine is gingery and flavourful. Help yourself to the steamed rice with lard.
